title: Building energy and thermal demand
mission: Curate atomic, source-grounded, reusable models for building energy and thermal quantities. Qualify each independently of any future composition or demo. Start with 3–5 distinct relationships as a review batch and identify further coverage; no chain is required.
priorities: Constant-power electricity consumption over a declared duration
Sensible heat for a declared mass and temperature change without phase change
Steady conductive heat loss through a bounded assembly
Thermal resistance or conductance for one material layer, only with clear geometry and temperature conventions
Audit the existing seasonal delivered-heat/electricity relationship if an independent source adds useful evidence
boundaries: Focus on thermal quantities and building-system efficiency; defer unrelated cash-flow and circuit models unless needed to explain source scope.
Separate energy from power; absolute temperature from temperature difference; point COP from seasonal whole-system performance
No defaults for weather, household size, hours, tariffs, efficiency, climate, or material properties
Exclude dynamic building simulation, empirical weather forecasts, full HVAC sizing, regulations and equipment recommendations
starter_sources: Find an accessible primary textbook or agency reference for each thermal relationship; starter links alone do not prove the equation
special_checks: Include a zero-demand boundary where valid
Reject nonpositive performance or inconsistent thermal scope when relevant
Explain the conversion between W, h and kWh explicitly, including any literal conversion constants
integration_expectation: Most new thermal quantities require vocabulary/dimension extensions. Preserve physical units and mark requires-extension. Existing energy-only projections may fit; do not reuse delivered_heat for arbitrary heat stored or electricity for generic energy.
coverage_guidance: These priorities are starting points, not a required chain or the final catalog limit. Preserve source scope, propose reusable quantity definitions, and list distinct next candidates. Potential compositions may be left unspecified.

title: Engineering finance and deterministic project economics
mission: Curate atomic, reusable deterministic cash-flow and project-economics relationships with explicit timing and price conventions. Start with 3–5 distinct relationships as a review batch; no heating use case or connected chain is required. This is mathematical formalization, not investment advice or forecasting.
priorities: Single future cash flow discounted to a specified valuation date
Equivalent annual amount or capital recovery for a bounded positive rate
A zero-rate uniform-series branch, kept distinct by domain from the existing positive-rate source model
A clearly scoped real/nominal rate conversion
A simple payback relationship only if it supplies a scientifically distinct nondiscounted definition, not another copy of an inverse discounted-present-value view
boundaries: Focus on currency basis, valuation timing, period conventions and deterministic cash-flow definitions.
Distinguish effective from nominal rates, annual from monthly periods, real from nominal amounts, and incremental from total cost
No assumed current market rates, taxes, investment returns, inflation forecasts or asset recommendations
Do not resubmit uniform-present-value@source-3 unchanged; submit new evidence as a duplicate/evidence proposal with clear rationale
special_checks: Use the NIST 2020 edition, precise equation and both printed/PDF page numbers; recheck them
Independently sum individual discounted cash flows for an annuity reference instead of repeating the annuity expression
Include rate approaching zero, timing or negative-cash-flow caveats; never silently substitute a different rate convention
integration_expectation: Some relationships can fit the current energy/currency profile, but a generic future payment is not automatically annual_saving and a recovery amount is not automatically operating_cost. New semantics need extension even when dimensions already match.
coverage_guidance: These priorities are starting points, not a required chain or the final catalog limit. Preserve source scope, propose reusable quantity definitions, and list distinct next candidates. Potential compositions may be left unspecified.

title: DC electricity and simple resistive circuits
mission: Curate atomic, reusable real scalar DC relationships with explicit component and operating conditions. Start with 3–5 distinct relationships as a review batch; no circuit chain is required. Equivalent rearrangements remain inverse views of one relationship.
priorities: Ohm's relationship for a bounded ohmic element
Electrical power from voltage and current under an explicit sign convention
Equivalent resistance of two series resistors
Equivalent resistance of two parallel resistors
Resistivity/length/area relationship only if temperature and uniform geometry are explicit
boundaries: Focus on electrical component and equivalent-resistance definitions; record known overlaps without duplicating an already supplied relationship.
Ohmic behavior is an applicability condition, not a universal device law
Separate signed current/voltage from nonnegative magnitudes and dissipated from supplied power
Exclude AC phasors, reactive power, full network solvers, transients, safety code and hardware installation advice
special_checks: Check limiting/zero cases without dividing by zero
Do not select a positive quadratic root unless the declared quantity is a magnitude or a justified guard excludes the negative root
Resistors-in-parallel cases must retain original denominator exclusions
integration_expectation: Voltage, current, resistance and power vocabulary/units are unsupported today. Return requires-extension candidates with proper SI dimensions; numerical checks still run in the kit.
coverage_guidance: These priorities are starting points, not a required chain or the final catalog limit. Preserve source scope, propose reusable quantity definitions, and list distinct next candidates. Potential compositions may be left unspecified.

title: Water flow, storage and bounded hydraulic energy
mission: Curate atomic, reusable scalar models for flow, volume, pressure, head and hydraulic energy/efficiency. Start with 3–5 distinct relationships as a review batch, independently of any future system composition.
priorities: Volumetric flow from cross-sectional area and mean speed
Volume transferred at a constant flow over a specified duration
Hydrostatic pressure difference for constant density
Ideal hydraulic power from flow and pressure difference or head, with source-grounded conventions
Pump input power or turbine output power with explicitly directed efficiency
boundaries: Focus on fluid quantities and hydraulic efficiency with their own source-grounded validity conditions.
Separate volumetric from mass flow, gauge from absolute pressure, gross from net head, and pump from turbine efficiency
Density and gravity are supplied parameters or attributed fixed constants, never hidden assumptions
Exclude river-flow forecasts, cavitation design, full pipe networks, empirical friction factors without calibration and environmental permits
starter_sources: Find primary agency/textbook evidence for hydraulic power and efficiency; do not infer pump/turbine conventions from a generic efficiency label
special_checks: Use zero-flow and invalid efficiency/domain cases
Distinguish pressure difference from elevation-only head; losses must be included or explicitly excluded
integration_expectation: Length, time, mass, pressure and power require vocabulary/dimension extensions. Research records must retain real physical units and application assumptions.
coverage_guidance: These priorities are starting points, not a required chain or the final catalog limit. Preserve source scope, propose reusable quantity definitions, and list distinct next candidates. Potential compositions may be left unspecified.

title: Classical mechanics, motion and energy
mission: Curate atomic, reusable scalar or one-dimensional mechanical relationships with explicit frames, signs and validity. Start with 3–5 distinct relationships as a review batch; qualify individual laws without constructing a motion-to-energy chain.
priorities: Classical translational kinetic energy
One-dimensional constant-acceleration displacement
One-dimensional velocity after constant acceleration
Gravitational potential-energy difference in an approximately uniform field
Constant-force work for collinear force/displacement, explicitly scoped to avoid an unsupported trigonometric operator
boundaries: Focus on classical mechanical quantities; do not silently identify them with electrically or thermally defined quantities.
Separate speed from signed velocity, displacement from path length, and mass from weight
Define reference frame and sign conventions; retain nonrelativistic and constant-acceleration assumptions
Exclude general vectors, relativistic dynamics, variable-force integration and multi-body simulation
special_checks: Explain both roots of a quadratic time/velocity inverse and when one can be excluded
Keep fixed physical constants in constants metadata, not freely solvable variable slots
Include zero-speed/zero-acceleration cases where valid and a negative-mass or missing-input rejection case
integration_expectation: Mass, speed, length, time and dimensionful powers need runtime work. Mark requires-extension even when numerical references pass; the current inverse solver does not make the forward unit system universal.
coverage_guidance: These priorities are starting points, not a required chain or the final catalog limit. Preserve source scope, propose reusable quantity definitions, and list distinct next candidates. Potential compositions may be left unspecified.

title: Elementary probability and event accounting
mission: Curate atomic, reusable scalar probability identities with explicit event meaning, population and dependence assumptions. Start with 3–5 distinct relationships as a review batch; no application chain or empirical forecast is required.
priorities: Complement probability
Two-event inclusion-exclusion
Conditional probability with nonzero conditioning probability
Two-event Bayes identity with all required probabilities supplied
Joint probability under explicitly asserted independence, only if distinct from an already curated conditional relationship
boundaries: Focus on probability identities; empirical probabilities must be explicitly supplied or independently evidenced.
A number between zero and one does not establish a calibrated probability
Do not infer independence, base rates, sample sizes or populations from a missing input
Exclude stochastic simulation, distributions needing integration, causal inference and prediction-market trading advice
starter_sources: Find an accessible primary university textbook/course or original reference; no source URLs were preverified for this optional assignment
special_checks: Guard probabilities within [0,1], denominators above zero, and joint probabilities against marginals
Use a finite contingency-table count as an independent oracle, not a repeat of Bayes' expression
Do not claim algebraic inversion establishes causal direction
integration_expectation: These quantities are dimensionless but have unsupported meanings. Never relabel probability as seasonal_performance or discount_rate to make a candidate execute.
coverage_guidance: These priorities are starting points, not a required chain or the final catalog limit. Preserve source scope, propose reusable quantity definitions, and list distinct next candidates. Potential compositions may be left unspecified.
